# gitea_secret_backend_role (Resource)

Manages a role on the Gitea secrets engine that mints short-lived scoped tokens for a Gitea user.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Each read of gitea/creds/ci-bot mints a token for the "ci-bot" user that is
# deleted from Gitea when the Vault lease is revoked or expires.
resource "gitea_secret_backend_role" "ci_bot" {
  backend  = gitea_secret_backend.gitea.path
  name     = "ci-bot"
  username = "ci-bot"
  scopes   = ["read:repository", "write:issue"]

  ttl     = 3600
  max_ttl = 28800
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `backend` (String) Mount path of the Gitea secrets engine.
- `name` (String) Name of the role.
- `scopes` (List of String) Gitea access-token scopes granted to minted tokens (e.g. ["read:repository", "write:issue"]).
- `username` (String) Gitea username that minted tokens belong to.

### Optional

- `max_ttl` (Number) Maximum lease TTL in seconds for tokens minted from this role.
- `token_name_prefix` (String) Prefix for the Gitea token name of each minted token (default "vault").
- `ttl` (Number) Default lease TTL in seconds for tokens minted from this role.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by "<backend>/roles/<name>".
terraform import gitea_secret_backend_role.ci_bot gitea/roles/ci-bot
```
